comment: Three controls are dead: the Random Seed knob, the Seed jack and the Reset jack are configured at Gendy.cpp:156, Gendy.cpp:169 and Gendy.cpp:172 and appear nowhere else in the file, so nothing reads them. The tenth knob is unnamed because Gendy.cpp:153 configures the Duration Dist Param CV knob a second time, with the name meant for it; that knob does work, Gendy.cpp:219. The pitch wanders between the note minus the spread and the note plus the spread, Gendy.cpp:189-190. This is a port of the SuperCollider gendy, after Peter Hoffmann's reconstruction of Xenakis.
